en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 stays in force as Saudel tracks east-southeast
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was about 280 kilometres east-southeast of Hong Kong at 6am; the Observatory said the chance of a Strong Wind Signal remains relatively low.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Standby Signal, No. 1 remained in force on Wednesday morning as Tropical Storm Saudel continued to move across the northern South China Sea after passing southeast of the territory overnight.

At 6am, Saudel was centred near 21.6 degrees north, 116.8 degrees east, about 280 kilometres east-southeast of Hong Kong. Maximum sustained winds near its centre were estimated at 65 kilometres per hour. A shipping warning issued at 6.31am said the storm was moving northeast at about five knots.

The Observatory has said the chance of issuing the Strong Wind Signal, No. 3 today and tomorrow is relatively low, unless Saudel intensifies significantly and its associated strong winds draw closer to the Pearl River Estuary. The No. 1 signal is expected to remain in force for the rest of Wednesday and Thursday morning, and a tropical cyclone warning may stay in place until later this week because of uncertainty in the storm’s later track near eastern Guangdong.

The forecast is mainly cloudy with occasional squally showers and thunderstorms. Winds will be moderate to fresh northerly, occasionally strong offshore and on high ground, with swells. The Observatory advised the public to keep up with the latest bulletins.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號早上維持 沙德爾位於東南偏東約280公里
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾上午6時位於本港東南偏東約280公里；天文台指今明兩日改發三號強風信號機會仍相對較低。
body: 香港天文台表示，一號戒備信號周三早上仍然生效。熱帶風暴沙德爾昨夜在本港東南面一帶掠過後，繼續在南海北部移動。
上午6時，沙德爾集結在北緯21.6度、東經116.8度附近，即香港東南偏東約280公里，中心附近最高持續風速估計每小晈65公里。天文台上午6時31分發出的船舶警告指，風暴向東北移動，時速約5海里。
天文台早前指出，除非沙德爾進一步顯著增強，且相關強風區更接近珠江口，否則今明兩日改發三號強風信號的機會相對較低。一號信號料想今日及周四早上維持；由於路徑及強度仍有變數，熱帶氣旋警告信號可能需要維持至本周後期。
預測今日大致多雲，間中有狂風驟雨及雷暴，吹和緩至清勁偏北風，離岸及高地間中吹強風，海有湧浪。天文台呼籲市民留意最新天氣報告。
